purpose: Proposed mathematical benchmark choices for expanding GC66–GC300 draft dossiers; not frozen or literature-cleared theorems.

01-wave-dynamics.model: Benchmark: `i∂ₜu=(Δ+1)²u−|u|²u+|u|⁴u` on `ℝ²`, `u(0)∈H²(ℝ²;ℂ)`. For coherent-mode questions write `u(t,x)=e^{iωt}φ(x)`, `φ∈H²`, conditional on a **proved nonzero** φ; do not assume the desired wave exists.
01-wave-dynamics.quantifiers: Freeze `ω∈ℝ`, an H² perturbation radius `0<δ≤1`, and time `t≥0`; measure an H² orbit distance, spectral projection, radiation norm, or asymptotic channel appropriate to the actual question.
01-wave-dynamics.observable: H² distance, resonant amplitude, radiation projection or asymptotic rate
01-wave-dynamics.failure: Nonexistence of the reference branch, a vanishing coupling coefficient, or a violating solution in the specified class.

02-confinement-curvature.model: Benchmark: `E_{λ,ε}(u)=‖(Δ+1)u‖²₂−½‖u‖⁴₄+⅓‖u‖⁶₆+λ‖Δu/(|u|+ε)‖²₂` on complex `H²(ℝ²)` at `‖u‖²₂=m`, with `m=1`, `λ∈[0,1]`, `ε∈[¼,1]`. This is a **proposed simplified** positive regularizer, not every historical WCT curvature operator.
02-confinement-curvature.quantifiers: Freeze translation/phase quotient, H² norm, domain and boundary geometry; specify whether a constant is uniform over λ and ε. If a curved manifold is essential, define its metric, Laplace–Beltrami operator and volume form anew.
02-confinement-curvature.observable: coercivity, minimizer compactness, curvature norm or localization radius
02-confinement-curvature.failure: A minimizing sequence escaping after symmetry reduction, a zero-amplitude pathology or a failure of uniform coercivity.

03-spectral-scattering.model: Benchmark: `H_V=(Δ+1)²+V` on `L²(ℝ²)`, domain `H⁴(ℝ²)`, with real compactly supported smooth `V`, `‖V‖∞≤1`. For periodic-band questions use instead a specified periodic V and the infinite-medium Bloch fibers; do not conflate these settings.
03-spectral-scattering.quantifiers: Specify the spectral parameter `z∈ℂ\ℝ`, energy window, perturbation V, resolvent weight and norm. For nonlinear resonance statements additionally fix an actual mode and a separate nonlinear evolution.
03-spectral-scattering.observable: spectrum, resolvent bound, spectral gap, scattering amplitude or coupling coefficient
03-spectral-scattering.failure: A counterexample potential, a threshold state, or failure of a claimed uniform resolvent or spectral limit.

04-variational-solitons.model: Benchmark: `E(u)=‖(Δ+1)u‖²₂−½‖u‖⁴₄+⅓‖u‖⁶₆`, `M(u)=‖u‖²₂`, `I(m)=inf_{M(u)=m}E(u)` on `H²(ℝ²;ℂ)`, with trial `m∈[½,2]`. Do **not** assume every trial mass admits an attained minimizer.
04-variational-solitons.quantifiers: State whether the property is for every m in the interval, one exact m, or a mass approaching a critical value. Factor translation/phase symmetries and specify energy topology.
04-variational-solitons.observable: mass-dependent infimum, splitting gap, branch index, compactness or asymptotic profile
04-variational-solitons.failure: Dichotomy, nonattainment, inequivalent minimizers, or a branch violating the claimed stability or gap.

05-higher-derivative-fields.model: Canonical baseline: `q∈ℝ²` with `L(q,v,a)=½⟨a,Wa⟩+⟨b(q,v),a⟩+c(q,v)`, real symmetric 2×2 W, smooth b,c, `v=q̇`, `a=q̈`; distinguish `det W≠0` from `det W=0`. A full PDE claim requires its own action, spatial boundary conditions and constraint algebra.
05-higher-derivative-fields.quantifiers: Specify finite-dimensional canonical versus linearized PDE versus nonlinear flow claims. Fix allowed constraints, phase space and what “stable” means: energy bounded below, strong hyperbolicity, or growth norm.
05-higher-derivative-fields.observable: Hamiltonian lower bound, constraint rank, dispersion roots or semigroup growth
05-higher-derivative-fields.failure: A negative canonical direction, incompatible constraint propagation, or an admissible degenerate countermodel in the quantified class.

06-inverse-observation-control.model: Benchmark observation `y=F(θ)+η`, `θ∈Θ=[−1,1]³¹`, `F:Θ→ℝ¹¹`, `‖η‖₂≤δ≤10⁻²`. For questions touching v18, instantiate its **actual frozen clipped forward map and branch** from Lean; a generic matrix is not the same model.
06-inverse-observation-control.quantifiers: Freeze the sensor design, observation times, measured norm, θ subset and noise law before proving injectivity, a recovery modulus, optimality or control. Account for prior restrictions explicitly.
06-inverse-observation-control.observable: rank/nullity, inverse modulus, minimax error, sensor count or control cost
06-inverse-observation-control.failure: Distinct θ with identical observations, reconstruction blow-up, sensor dropout or counterexample experiment.

07-pattern-formation.model: Benchmark real Swift–Hohenberg flow `∂ₜu=r u−(Δ+1)²u+u³−u⁵`, `r∈[−¼,¼]`, on periodic `𝕋_L²`, `L≥2π`, data in H⁴. For continuum Bloch sidebands, use a periodic stripe on `ℝ²` and specify the Floquet decomposition.
07-pattern-formation.quantifiers: Choose a stationary stripe/hexagon/front, perturbation topology, box or whole-plane domain and observable (spectral sign, wavenumber, defect count or speed). State uniformity in r,L.
07-pattern-formation.observable: Bloch eigenvalue, wavelength selection, front speed or defect rate
07-pattern-formation.failure: An unstable sideband, competing pattern or lack of convergence as L→∞.

08-topology-multicomponent.model: Topological benchmark: smooth `n:ℝ³→S²` approaching a constant at infinity (hence `S³→S²`) with finite Faddeev–Skyrme-type energy `∫(|∇n|²+Σ_{i<j}|∂ᵢn×∂ⱼn|²) dx`. For vector-wave dynamics, separately freeze the two-component H² cubic–quintic equation; do not identify the two models.
08-topology-multicomponent.quantifiers: Fix integer degree/Hopf invariant, finite-energy class, nonvanishing hypotheses, admissible homotopies and whether evolution is continuous. Distinguish classical topology from energy-constrained dynamics.
08-topology-multicomponent.observable: topological charge, energy gap, admissible path, zero hitting or spectral index
08-topology-multicomponent.failure: A continuous homotopy, zero-mediated charge change, or a counterexample to the proposed energy barrier.

09-computability-complexity.model: Finite binary reversible wave-cell benchmark on the ring `ℤ/nℤ`: `x_j(t+1)=x_j(t−1)⊕x_{j−1}(t)⊕x_{j+1}(t)` with input of two initial slices. Time T is unary encoded unless explicitly changed; a pair-state update is reversible.
09-computability-complexity.quantifiers: Specify output bit/predicate, uniformity, input size n, horizon T and cost (gate count, depth, bits or communication). Prove reductions only for the fixed rule/encoding; no automatic physical P versus NP claim.
09-computability-complexity.observable: time, sequential work, parallel depth, memory or communication lower bound
09-computability-complexity.failure: An exact faster algorithm, simulation protocol or adversarial lower-bound witness for the frozen decision problem.

10-lean-certified-analysis.model: Use the repository's pinned Lean 4/Mathlib project and named MathProofs definitions (H², Fourier operators, nonlinear energy, semigroup, or constraint maps). Work on one exact theorem declaration and its analytic paper correspondence; do not treat formalization of known analysis as a newly unsolved theorem.
10-lean-certified-analysis.quantifiers: Freeze the Lean statement, imports, model topology, hypothesis dependencies and an explicit axiom audit; success requires `lake build` and matching analytic quantifiers.
10-lean-certified-analysis.observable: kernel-checked theorem, dependency audit, norm bound or validated certificate
10-lean-certified-analysis.failure: A counterexample to a weakened hypothesis, a type mismatch or an unclosed Lean obligation; do not replace it by sorry or axioms.

11-physical-emergence-multiscale.model: Benchmark lattice: `q̈_j=ε⁻²(q_{j+1}−2q_j+q_{j−1})−V'(q_j)`, `j∈ℤ`, `V(s)=s²/2−s⁴/4+s⁶/6`, `ε∈(0,1]`, initially finite-energy compactly supported data. Vector/optical/3D variants need an independently specified microscopic Hamiltonian.
11-physical-emergence-multiscale.quantifiers: Freeze interpolation, rescaled initial data, observation time `0≤t≤T/ε` (fixed T) and a norm for the error as ε→0. Identify hypotheses yielding uniform bounds.
11-physical-emergence-multiscale.observable: effective coefficient, ε-error, long-time uniformity or lattice-continuum discrepancy
11-physical-emergence-multiscale.failure: Resonance, failure of uniform regularity, or noncommuting parameter limits.

12-photonic-wave-computing.model: Finite classical coherent-amplitude benchmark: `z_out=Uz_in+e`, unitary `U∈ℂ^{N×N}`, `N≥2`, `‖z_in‖₂≤1`, noise `‖e‖₂≤10⁻²`, and threshold readout `b_j=1{|z_out,j|²≥τ}`, `τ∈(0,1)`. Intensity detection is nonlinear; it is not passive coherent propagation.
12-photonic-wave-computing.quantifiers: Freeze source encoding, device size N, U, detector threshold, control/reset budget and error tolerance before quantifying over all valid input words and disturbances.
12-photonic-wave-computing.observable: gate truth table, noise margin, power budget, resource scaling or calibrated output
12-photonic-wave-computing.failure: A competing circuit, indistinguishable inputs at threshold, or a violated worst-case noise margin.

special_corrections.GC97: Winding requires explicit nonvanishing and boundary data. Use an annulus `A={1<|x|<2}` and distinguish boundary winding from changes through interior zeros.
special_corrections.GC124: A nonzero periodic stripe on `ℝ²` is not L². Compare both branches on a fixed 2-torus at equal mass per area, or use a genuinely localized modulation.
special_corrections.GC143: Generic fourth-order spatial dispersion lacks finite propagation speed. Seek a quantified off-cone decay estimate instead of a sharp light cone.
special_corrections.GC165: Existing F09 Lean proves a scoped clipped-map rank/nullity result. Specify a different clipping cell, extra observation or global domain before asserting a new identifiability gap.
special_corrections.GC177: For continuous Eckhaus sidebands use a periodic stripe on `ℝ²` with Bloch exponent; a fixed torus samples only discrete sidebands.
special_corrections.GC196: Compare to classical Hopf/Skyrme charge inequalities. Fix the energy normalization and state which constant or class is genuinely beyond known cases.
special_corrections.GC197: The unrestricted homotopy question for maps `S³→S²` is already settled by the Hopf invariant; investigate additional energy, PDE or preimage-knot restrictions only.
special_corrections.GC200: Classical benchmark: for a flat torus side lengths Lx,Ly and winding (m,n), the Dirichlet phase energy is minimized by the harmonic representative at `2π²(m² Ly/Lx+n² Lx/Ly)`. This is not a new unsolved problem.
special_corrections.GC212: Continuous nonvanishing sample paths preserve topological degree. The nontrivial question concerns zero-hitting or loss of regularity under precisely stated stochastic forcing.
special_corrections.GC235: Fourier–Plancherel is established mathematics and partly formalized already; audit `L2Fourier.lean` and `FourierShellL2.lean` before creating another Lean deliverable.
special_corrections.GC247: Classical unitarity is conditional on complete wave operators. Frame as a Lean proof and correspondence task, not a new universal scattering theorem.
special_corrections.GC248: Homotopy invariance of winding is classical. The substantive PDE task is proving nonvanishing and regularity that permit application.
special_corrections.GC252: Under precompactness and strict Lyapunov hypotheses, LaSalle-type results are classical; isolate the missing formal PDE hypotheses rather than asserting unconditional convergence.
special_corrections.GC278: Threshold detection is nonlinear even when interferometers are passive. Specify whether intermediate detectors, active feedforward, regeneration and fanout are permitted.
special_corrections.GC286: Choose a concrete workload, input distribution, clock rate and detector/source/cooling/control overhead before any energy-per-correct-operation comparison.
special_corrections.GC300: Freeze an explicit two-bit arithmetic truth table, optical U, input code, sensor transfer intervals, noise set, and compositional compiler correctness statement.
